{{Quote|Interference from the star. It's why Asturias was abandoned. After its sun went red giant, prolonged exposure to its radiation proved detrimental to man ''and'' machine.|A [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]]|<ref name="Tales" />}}
A [[Color/Legends|light orange]] '''sun'''<ref name="Tales" /> was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Epsi Collective/Legends|Epsi Collective]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], in the [[Asturias system/Legends|Asturias system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> and was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the industrial [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Asturias]].<ref name="Tales" /> By [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. As {{Tales|22|Honor Bound}} dates itself to approximately a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the events of ''Attack of the Clones'', it must take place around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the sun had become a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]], producing harmful [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] that forced the inhabitants of Asturias and their machinery to abandon the moon after they were exposed to the radiation for a prolonged amount of [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Tales" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sun appeared in the flashbacks of the short story "[[Honor Bound]]," which was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Tales" /> on [[February 23]], [[2005]]<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/10-154/Star-Wars-Tales-22|text=STAR WARS TALES #22}}</ref> as part of the [[Star Wars Tales 22|twenty-second]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' series. The issue was written by [[Ian Edginton]] and illustrated by [[Steve Pugh]].<ref name="Tales" />
